title: Synthesis, Biological Evaluation, DNA Binding, and Molecular Docking of Hybrid 4,6-Dihydrazone Pyrimidine Derivatives as Antitumor Agents.
authors: Lan, Hairong; Song, Junying; Yuan, Juan; Xing, Aiping; Zeng, Dai; Hao, Yating; Zhang, Zhenqiang; Feng, Shuying
one_liner_zh: 该文合成并评估嘧啶衍生物的抗肿瘤活性，含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但核心是药物小分子-DNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA或TF-DNA体系，方法仅常规对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: In the present paper, on the basis of molecular hybridization, a series of 4,6-dihydrazone pyrimidine derivatives containing the pyridine moiety were synthesized, structurally characterized, and evaluated in vitro for their antitumor activity. According to the results, all the tested compounds demonstrated broad-spectrum antitumor activity against selected tumor cell lines (MCF-7, BGC-823, A549, and BEL-7402) and no obvious toxicity toward normal cells HL-7702. In particular, compounds 10a and 10f were found to be the most promising antitumor agents among the tested compounds against BGC-823 cells (IC(50) = 9.00 muM and 7.89 muM) and BEL-7402 cells (IC(50) = 6.70 muM and 7.66 muM), respectively. Compounds 10a and 10f exhibited higher potency against BGC-823 and BEL-7402 than the positive control 5-FU (IC(50) = 15.18 muM and 15.81 muM). Further mechanism investigations demonstrated that compounds 10a and 10f could significantly increase the level of cellular ROS and induce early apoptosis of BGC-823 cells in a dose-dependent manner. Moreover, the DNA binding results from UV/Vis, CD spectroscopy, and molecular docking studies indicated that 10a and 10f bind with DNA via groove binding and partial intercalation. These results demonstrated that 10a and 10f may serve as novel lead compounds for the discovery of more dihydrazone pyrimidine derivatives with improved antitumor potency and selectivity.
abstract_zh: 本文基于分子杂交策略，合成了一系列含吡啶部分的4,6-二腙嘧啶衍生物，对其进行了结构表征，并评估了其体外抗肿瘤活性。结果表明，所有测试化合物对所选肿瘤细胞系（MCF-7、BGC-823、A549和BEL-7402）均表现出广谱抗肿瘤活性，且对正常细胞HL-7702无明显毒性。特别地，化合物10a和10f在测试化合物中对BGC-823细胞（IC(50) = 9.00 μM和7.89 μM）和BEL-7402细胞（IC(50) = 6.70 μM和7.66 μM）显示出最有前景的抗肿瘤效果。化合物10a和10f对BGC-823和BEL-7402的效力高于阳性对照5-FU（IC(50) = 15.18 μM和15.81 μM）。进一步的机制研究表明，化合物10a和10f能显著提高细胞ROS水平，并以剂量依赖性方式诱导BGC-823细胞早期凋亡。此外，通过UV/Vis、CD光谱和分子对接研究获得的DNA结合结果表明，10a和10f通过沟槽结合和部分嵌入方式与DNA结合。这些结果证明，10a和10f可能作为新型先导化合物，用于发现具有更高抗肿瘤效力和选择性的更多二腙嘧啶衍生物。
